item.title: Readvertisement: Construction Specialist (P-3), TA, 364 days #00136883, Dhaka – Bangladesh, APR (Nationals of Bangladesh are not eligible to apply)
item.description: Under the direct supervision and guidance of the Chief, Supply and Logistics, the Construction Specialist will be responsible for managing and monitoring construction activities across the Country Office, including school infrastructures, health centers, and other rehabilitation projects, while providing technical support to UNICEF Programmes and Operations. The incumbent will lead the preparation of the Construction Annual Workplan, collaborate closely with UNICEF programme sections and government counterparts, support the preparation of design and technical documents, contribute to procurement processes, and ensure effective monitoring of construction projects. This role offers an opportunity to contribute to quality infrastructure initiatives that support UNICEF's mission of advancing the rights and well-being of children in Bangladesh.

item.title: Deputy Representative Operations, (P-4) Fixed Term, #71972, Monrovia, Liberia, WCAR
item.description: An exciting and challenging opportunity is now available within the UNICEF Liberia Country Office for a highly motivated and dedicated Deputy Representative, Operations (P-4). The Operations function is a strategic Business Partner role within the Senior Management Team, assuring the best use of UNICEF assets in alignment with sound management practices, office priorities and goals to deliver results for children. The function supports the Head of the Office on managing the office and monitoring operations and programmes as needed while providing advice on best and innovative management practices to enhance office performance.

item.title: People and Culture Manager, (P-4), TA (6 months), #138386, Kinshasa, Dem. Rep. of Congo-WCAR
item.description: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is responding to its 17th Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) outbreak, confirmed in May 2026 and affecting Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces. The situation remains complex and evolving, with transmission occurring in both community and health-care settings. Response efforts are led by national authorities in a context shaped by health system limitations, logistical constraints, insecurity, displacement, and diverse community perceptions influencing health-seeking behaviors.UNICEF supports the Government through a multi-sectoral approach, focusing on community engagement, surveillance, infection prevention, and the continuity of essential services for vulnerable populations.This context requires strong coordination, adaptability, and cultural sensitivity to support effective and equitable response efforts, particularly for children and at-risk communities.

item.title: Immunization Specialist (P-3), ΤΑ, (364 days), #00138384, Moroni – Comoros, ESAR

item.title: Chief Child Protection, P-4, Fixed Term Position, Malaysia, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, #00068521
item.description: Come join us in beautiful, complex, and diverse Malaysia to lead our high-performing child protection team and help deliver lasting results for children. As Chief, you will provide strategic leadership and technical oversight for the development, implementation, and monitoring of child protection programmes, while fostering partnerships with government, donors, UN agencies, the private sector, and business partners. This role offers a unique opportunity to influence national policies, contribute to the Malaysia MADANI framework and the 13th Malaysia Plan, and drive innovation to strengthen systems so that every child is protected, included, healthy, learning and able to realize their full potential.

item.title: Deputy Representative Programme, P-5, Nairobi, Kenya #1625
item.description:
The Deputy Representative reports to the CO Representative for general supervision and direction. The Deputy Representative serves as the principal adviser on the overall management of the CO, development of CO policies and strategies; and under delegated authority, for coordinating and managing all phases of the Country Office Programme, from formulation to delivery of results in accordance with UNICEF’s Strategic Plans, standards of performance and accountability framework, ethics, and integrity.
The Deputy Representative together with Chief/Partnerships supports the Representative in leading and leveraging partnerships with both public and private sectors for the achievement of results and fulfilment of the rights of children.
In fragile and humanitarian settings, the Deputy Representative is accountable for the delivery of a timely, efficient and principled humanitarian programmes, in accordance with UNICEF global Policy and Framework for humanitarian action.

item.title: Education Specialist (Learning Recovery) (P-3), TA, 364 days, #138278, Yangon - Myanmar, APR (extendable subject to programme requirements and funding)
item.description: Join UNICEF as an Education Specialist (Learning Recovery) and help shape innovative solutions that improve learning outcomes for children affected by crisis and disrupted schooling. In this impactful role, you will lead the design, implementation, and evaluation of learning recovery strategies, strengthen foundational learning, support digital learning initiatives, and work closely with government partners and stakeholders to build resilient, inclusive education systems. This is an exciting opportunity for an education professional with strong programme management, data analysis, and strategic planning experience who is passionate about ensuring every child can access quality education and reach their full potential.

item.title: Child Protection Specialist (P-3), TA, 364 days, #00136567, Port Au Prince – Haiti, LACR
item.description: UNICEF Haiti is looking for a committed and results-oriented Child Protection Specialist to help strengthen programmes that protect children from violence, abuse, exploitation and other forms of harm. Based in Port-au-Prince and reporting to the Chief, Child Protection, you will play an important role in supporting the planning, implementation, monitoring and reporting of child protection programmes, ensuring that interventions are timely, effective and focused on results.Experience working at the international level, in a developing country and in an emergency context is required. And in this role, you will provide technical and operational support throughout the programme cycle, contribute to coordination and partnerships with government counterparts and other stakeholders, and support knowledge sharing, innovation and capacity building. Through your work, you will help translate UNICEF’s priorities into concrete and sustainable results and contribute to a stronger protective environment for children across Haiti.If you have the experience, commitment and passion to make a meaningful difference for children in Haiti, we encourage you to apply and join UNICEF Haiti in advancing the rights, protection and well-being of every child.

item.title: Social & Behavior Change Specialist (P-3), Fixed Term, #00134005, Global Programme Division (WASH), COE Nairobi, Kenya
item.description: Join UNICEF’s Global Programme Division (GPD) Centre of Excellence for WASH in Nairobi and help drive global efforts to protect children and communities from waterborne diseases and public health emergencies. This exciting role sits within the High Impact Solutions Team and focuses on strengthening Risk Communication and Community Engagement (RCCE) and Accountability to Affected Populations (AAP) across UNICEF programmes worldwide.Working with Country Offices, governments, and partners, you will provide technical support, contribute to capacity building and knowledge sharing, and help translate global strategies into effective action at country level. item.title: Innovation Specialist, P-3, Fixed Term Position, Malawi, Lilongwe, Malawi, #00103341
item.description: Join UNICEF Malawi as Innovation Specialist, to lead and mainstream innovation and digital technology-enabled programming across the country programme. You will provide technical leadership and support to innovation planning and technology-enabled programme design, implementation, monitoring and documentation across programme sections and with partners. The role will coordinate office-wide innovation and digital transformation priorities; advise government counterparts on strengthening child-centred digital transformation, responsible artificial intelligence (AI) governance, and technology policy implementation systems; support the testing, scale-up, and institutionalization of innovation products and technology-enabled solutions; strengthen results tracking, evidence use and knowledge management; build staff and partner capacity in innovation and digital impact; support sustainable and innovative financing approaches for scaling promising solutions; and foster partnerships with government, UN, NGO, academia, private sector and technology actors. The post collaborates across programme sections and works closely with the UNICEF Digital Impact Division, Centre of Excellences, and the Office of Innovation, where applicable
